description: This PHP file renders the detailed view of a Lead record in the vtigerCRM system. It loads necessary dependencies, retrieves lead data, checks permissions, and prepares data for display in the Smarty templating engine, including options for email, lead conversion, merging, and related lists.

classes.description: Class responsible for handling lead conversion user interface logic.

classes.name: VtigerCRM_Smarty
